    summary: Generates the 720p60 raster and selectable test-pattern pixel stream.
    clocks:
      - {name: clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 74.25}
    resets:
      - {name: rst, port: rst, clock: clk, polarity: active_low, style: async}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: pattern_id, dir: in, width: 2, clock: clk}
      - {name: frame_count, dir: out, width: 32, clock: clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: m_axis_tvalid, dir: out, clock: clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: m_axis_tready, dir: in, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tdata, dir: out, width: 12, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tuser, dir: out, width: 3, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tlast, dir: out, clock: clk}
    data_formats:
      - {name: channel, format: u4, packing: "One unsigned 4-bit RGB channel"}
      - {name: frame_counter, format: u32, packing: "Unsigned completed-frame count"}
    interfaces:
      - name: out
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: master
        prefix: m_axis
        clock: clk
        reset: rst
        tdata:
          width: 12
          fields:
            - {name: red, bits: [11, 8], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [7, 4], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [3, 0], format: channel}
        tuser:
          - {bit: 0, name: active, meaning: "Pixel is in the active picture"}
          - {bit: 1, name: hsync, meaning: "Positive horizontal sync level for this pixel"}
          - {bit: 2, name: vsync, meaning: "Positive vertical sync level for this pixel"}
        tlast: "Assert on the final pixel clock of each 1650-clock line."
        packet_beats: 1650
        backpressure: true
        source_gaps: false
    registers:
      bus: top
      map:
        - name: PATTERN
          offset: 0x00
          access: RW
          reset: 0
          width: 32
          fields:
            - {name: pattern_id, bits: [1, 0], port: pattern_id}
        - name: FRAME
          offset: 0x04
          access: RO
          reset: 0
          width: 32
          volatile: true
          fields:
            - {name: frame_count, bits: [31, 0], port: frame_count}
    throughput:
      - {interface: out, beats_per_cycle: 1}
  median_filter:
    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: median_filter
    summary: Computes independent per-channel 3x3 medians while preserving raster sidebands.
    clocks:
      - {name: clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 74.25}
    resets:
      - {name: rst, port: rst, clock: clk, polarity: active_low, style: async}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: s_axis_tvalid, dir: in, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tready, dir: out, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tdata, dir: in, width: 12, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tuser, dir: in, width: 3, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tlast, dir: in, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tvalid, dir: out, clock: clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: m_axis_tready, dir: in, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tdata, dir: out, width: 12, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tuser, dir: out, width: 3, clock: clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tlast, dir: out, clock: clk}
    data_formats:
      - {name: channel, format: u4, packing: "One unsigned 4-bit RGB channel"}
    interfaces:
      - name: in
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: slave
        prefix: s_axis
        clock: clk
        reset: rst
        tdata:
          width: 12
          fields:
            - {name: red, bits: [11, 8], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [7, 4], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [3, 0], format: channel}
        tuser:
          - {bit: 0, name: active, meaning: "Pixel is in the active picture"}
          - {bit: 1, name: hsync, meaning: "Positive horizontal sync level for this pixel"}
          - {bit: 2, name: vsync, meaning: "Positive vertical sync level for this pixel"}
        tlast: "Assert on the final pixel clock of each 1650-clock line."
        packet_beats: 1650
        backpressure: true
        source_gaps: false
      - name: out
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: master
        prefix: m_axis
        clock: clk
        reset: rst
        tdata:
          width: 12
          fields:
            - {name: red, bits: [11, 8], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [7, 4], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [3, 0], format: channel}
        tuser:
          - {bit: 0, name: active, meaning: "Pixel is in the active picture"}
          - {bit: 1, name: hsync, meaning: "Positive horizontal sync level for this pixel"}
          - {bit: 2, name: vsync, meaning: "Positive vertical sync level for this pixel"}
        tlast: "Assert on the final pixel clock of each 1650-clock line."
        packet_beats: 1650
        backpressure: true
        source_gaps: true
    throughput:
      - {interface: out, beats_per_cycle: 1}
  vga_output:
    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: vga_output
    summary: Drives VGA sync and RGB pins from the filtered raster stream, blanking colour when required.
    clocks:
      - {name: clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 74.25}
    resets:
      - {name: rst, port: rst, clock: clk, polarity: active_low, style: async}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: btnc, dir: in, width: 1, clock: async}
      - {name: pixel_clock_stable, dir: in, width: 1, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tvalid, dir: in, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tready, dir: out, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tdata, dir: in, width: 12, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tuser, dir: in, width: 3, clock: clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tlast, dir: in, clock: clk}

      - {name: vga_g, dir: out, width: 4, clock: clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: vga_b, dir: out, width: 4, clock: clk, reset_value: 0}
    data_formats:

    interfaces:
      - name: in
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: slave
        prefix: s_axis
        clock: clk
        reset: rst
        tdata:
          width: 12
          fields:
            - {name: red, bits: [11, 8], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [7, 4], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [3, 0], format: channel}
        tuser:
          - {bit: 0, name: active, meaning: "Pixel is in the active picture"}
          - {bit: 1, name: hsync, meaning: "Positive horizontal sync level for this pixel"}
          - {bit: 2, name: vsync, meaning: "Positive vertical sync level for this pixel"}
        tlast: "Assert on the final pixel clock of each 1650-clock line."
        packet_beats: 1650
        backpressure: true
        source_gaps: true
    throughput:
      - {interface: in, beats_per_cycle: 1}
  fpga_shell:
    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: shell
    hdl_top: fpga_shell
    summary: Owns the USB-UART test interface and register window.
    clocks:
      - {name: clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 100}
    resets:
      - {name: rst, port: rst, clock: clk, polarity: active_low, style: async}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: uart_rx, dir: in, width: 1, clock: async}
      - {name: uart_tx, dir: out, width: 1, clock: async, reset_value: 1}

  # The MMCM-derived pixel clock and its LOCKED indication are design clock resources.
  # The test shell is present as shell/rtl/fpga_shell.sv and is described separately above.
  module_specs:
    video_timing: |
      Generate a continuous 1650-by-750 raster at 74.25 MHz with 1280-by-720 active pixels.
      Produce positive sync sidebands and pattern 0 as eight 160-pixel vertical colour bars
      in the specified order. Latch a supported pattern selection at a frame boundary, reject
      unsupported selections, and increment the 32-bit completed-frame counter once per frame.
    median_filter: |
      For active pixels, compute each RGB channel's median over its corresponding 3-by-3
      neighbourhood. Replicate the nearest active-picture pixel beyond each active-picture
      edge, including corners. Preserve the pixel's active, sync, and line-end association
      through the filter pipeline.
    vga_output: |
      Drive the VGA sync pins from the aligned stream sidebands. Drive RGB to zero outside
      active video, when BTNC is pressed, or when the pixel clock is not stable. Otherwise
      drive the filtered 4-bit RGB channels.
    fpga_shell: |
      The always-present shell owns USB-UART at 115200 baud and the 0x80-0xFF register
      window. Implement the defaulted newline-terminated 8-N-1 ASCII commands PATTERN n,
      FRAME?, and ID?, returning requested values as ASCII lines.

  video_timing: |
    Generate a continuous 1650-by-750 raster at 74.25 MHz with 1280-by-720 active pixels.
    Produce positive sync sidebands and pattern 0 as eight 160-pixel vertical colour bars
    in the specified order. Latch a supported pattern selection at a frame boundary, reject
    unsupported selections, and increment the 32-bit completed-frame counter once per frame.
  median_filter: |
    For active pixels, compute each RGB channel's median over its corresponding 3-by-3
    neighbourhood. Replicate the nearest active-picture pixel beyond each active-picture
    edge, including corners. Preserve the pixel's active, sync, and line-end association
    through the filter pipeline.
  vga_output: |
    Drive the VGA sync pins from the aligned stream sidebands. Drive RGB to zero outside
    active video, when BTNC is pressed, or when the pixel clock is not stable. Otherwise
    drive the filtered 4-bit RGB channels.
  fpga_shell: |
    The always-present shell owns USB-UART at 115200 baud and the 0x80-0xFF register
    window. Implement the defaulted newline-terminated 8-N-1 ASCII commands PATTERN n,
    FRAME?, and ID?, returning requested values as ASCII lines.

    text: "For each output pixel, compute the median independently for each colour channel over the corresponding 3 x 3 pixel neighbourhood."

module_specs:
  video_timing: |
    Generate a continuous 1650-by-750 raster at 74.25 MHz with 1280-by-720 active pixels.
    Produce positive sync sidebands and pattern 0 as eight 160-pixel vertical colour bars
    in the specified order. Latch a supported pattern selection at a frame boundary, reject
    unsupported selections, and increment the 32-bit completed-frame counter once per frame.
  median_filter: |
    For active pixels, compute each RGB channel's median over its corresponding 3-by-3
    neighbourhood. Replicate the nearest active-picture pixel beyond each active-picture
    edge, including corners. Preserve the pixel's active, sync, and line-end association
    through the filter pipeline.
  vga_output: |
    Drive the VGA sync pins from the aligned stream sidebands. Drive RGB to zero outside
    active video, when BTNC is pressed, or when the pixel clock is not stable. Otherwise
    drive the filtered 4-bit RGB channels.
  fpga_shell: |
    The always-present shell owns USB-UART at 115200 baud and the 0x80-0xFF register
    window. Implement the defaulted newline-terminated 8-N-1 ASCII commands PATTERN n,
    FRAME?, and ID?, returning requested values as ASCII lines.
